name: fab
title: Floating action button
description: Keeps one task reachable over scrolling content, as a button or a link, collapsing to its icon on phones.

when: One main task must stay reachable while people scroll: contact, new item.

guidance.rule: At most one per screen; never over a dialog or sheet.

builtIn: Keeps its label as the accessible name when collapsed to an icon.
Links that open a new tab say so.
youProvide: A verb label for the task.

Fab.name: label
Fab.description: The task, as a verb ("Contact us", "New order"); also the name when icon-only.

Fab.name: href
Fab.description: A link (a chat or contact URL) instead of an action; it opens in a new tab unless `target` says otherwise.

Fab.name: target
Fab.description:
Where `href` opens. `_blank` (default) follows Link's external convention: `noopener noreferrer` and the
new-tab words for screen readers. `_self` keeps an in-app link in the page, through the host router.

Fab.name: placement
Fab.description: `fixed` (default): bottom-end above the safe area. `inline`: in the flow (previews, docs).

Fab.name: collapseOnScroll
Fab.description: Collapse to icon-only on phones after the first scroll (default true).

Fab.name: iconOnly
Fab.description: Icon-only at every width, as Button's `iconOnly`: a round button; `label` stays its accessible name.
